svg.aria-label: Hey, I'm Arthur. I'm a founder and engineer building infrastructure for AI agents. My new company, Kubi, gives every agent a computer of its own in the cloud. I also co-founded Qoris, where I built the agent platform from the ground up as CTO, and before that I founded SalesGet, an AI sales agent, and sold it. 4,730 contributions in the last year.
